new_ops.reason: Softmax attention whose logits get an added learned scalar per head indexed by a log-spaced bucket (32 buckets, saturating at offset 128) of the key-query offset; table shared across layers. Needs an attention primitive accepting a [heads, num_buckets] bias table and a bucketing rule over (i - j).

output.notes: Described one decoder block of the Base config (the paper's baseline / T5-Base); the encoder block is the same minus cross-attention and with non-causal attention. Configs are listed in the paper's order (Base, Small, Large, 3B, 11B). The norm scales activations and has no bias; whether it subtracts the mean is not stated, so it is not mapped to rmsnorm. No eps is stated. A final layer norm after the stack is not stated and is omitted. Small's d_kv is not stated, so it is left not_stated. Biases in the linear layers, n_kv_heads and the attention scale are not stated. q/k/v out is given as heads*d_kv (12*64) for Base.
